Claire S.: Quick handoff — I'm OOO after 17:30 PT, @Ben K. is covering. Notes:
- RDW-3456: KV-cache miss spike remediation deployed to prod yesterday; SLO improved but we're still seeing intermittent 5xx from model-runtime.
- Action item from 2026-02-11 postmortem (#7): circuit-breaker config PR merged but not rolled out to prod.
- Canary for quantized-v2 is at 30% (rolling); watch latency tail.
Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/rdw-3456

Ben K.: Thanks — ack takeover. I'll validate the CB rollout and keep an eye on the 5xx rate. Who owns the prod promote for #7?

Alice M.: I ran canary deploy earlier but didn't promote to prod. Staging shows error_rate down: `0.9% -> 0.3%`. Prod currently ~0.7%.
PromQL I used:
``nsum(rate(errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))
```
I'll kick a gradual promote if Ben gives the go.

Dan P.: I can swap weekend nights if needed — taking Sunday 22:00–06:00 PT. Ben, want to swap Sun night coverage?

Ben K.: Appreciate it, added you for Sunday. I'll monitor dashboards tonight and do the CB promote if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Deployment: `rdw/cb-config` canary -> promoted to canary by Alice M. (2026-03-01T14:12Z)

Claire S.: FYI saw two traces at 14:40 that looked like the earlier root cause; same stack and timeout pattern. If 5xx spikes >2% for 5m we should reopen RDW-3456.

Ben K.: Noted. I've set an alert: `model_runtime_5xx_rate > 0.02 for 5m`. If it fires I'll open incident and ping #incidents + @oncall.

Alice M.: Added a regression test to eval harness: `tests/kv_cache_repro.py`. Will run nightly and report failures to #eng-ml.

Claire S.: Perfect. Ben — if you promote, please post the promote time and canary metrics here. I'll follow up on the postmortem action tracker for #7 ownership.

Ben K.: Will do. Starting final sanity checks now (curl health check: `curl -sS https://canary.internal/health | jq .`), will report in 10m :thumbsup:
